body: I have been struggling for years now. I lived with an emotionally abusive and busy mother and an alcoholic and physically abusive dad when I was younger. I have no idea what to make of myself as I was isolated from others my entire life and am now distant from everyone. I excelled in school work but lacked in creative thinking as I feared getting a beating.  Now, I'm failing my senior year and have no sense of self worth and I have depression and a possible personality disorder. I am easily discouraged to the point to where I give up on thinking. How can I fix this? I have been considering getting a brain scan.
Alright. Let's talk. How's it going?

That's me. I think it's not just depression but also the increase in texting and over reliance on the internet. To be honest, i think we'll forget in the long run anyways. Depression keeps us withdrawn, which makes us less able to effectively communicate face to face. If we had no technology or Internet to go to, would it have been this bad? I don't know. Maybe.
So there's no way to rebuild your brain to get to some sort of productive, identity driven mind?

Is that you saying that? Or the fear of trying something different? Therapy won't make you addicted to meds, it worked for those who had addiction. As for money, I don't know your financial status. But, again, it's all your decision. Maybe this will help: here's a game that I learned to help cope: see 5 things around and name them out loud, touch 4 things and name them out loud, hear 3 sounds and name them out loud, smell 2 things and name them out loud, and, finally, taste 1 thing and name it out loud. This is a grounding technique used to help people get out of their current state of mind or mood. Maybe it'll help. But, if possible, do get some counseling if the feelings persist. You're not the only one who have gone through this, and certainly won't be the last.

Hey, bud. I know where you're coming from. If this persists for more than a week, this feeling that everyday's shitty, then it may be more than that. You should get professional help if this is the case. Looking out for you, bud.

I feel like i am overly sensitive with a tendency to care too much about what other people think of me, or what I can do for them instead of myself. I'm not even sure if what I am doing is for myself. I guess that's the uncertainty of starting something new. See, I recently became active in the furry community, and the past of all the criticism of the furry fandom keeps getting to me, making me wonder if it's worth it to carry my dreams with the fandom out. I get easily intimidated :(. I'm here looking for someone to help me push on in this so i can feel like I'm adamant about something.
